# Project Structure

## Directory Organization

```
matthew-field.ca/
├── content/                        # MDX source files (Velite input)
│   ├── blog/                       # Blog posts
│   │   └── my-post.mdx
│   ├── projects/                   # Project showcase entries
│   │   └── my-project.mdx
│   ├── contributions/              # Open-source contribution entries
│   │   └── my-contribution.mdx
│   ├── resources/                  # Resource/bookmark entries
│   │   └── my-resource.mdx
│   └── pages/                      # Standalone page content (about, now, colophon)
│       └── about.mdx
├── src/
│   ├── app/                        # Next.js App Router (routing + layouts)
│   │   ├── layout.tsx              # Root layout (<html>, <body>, providers)
│   │   ├── not-found.tsx           # Global 404
│   │   ├── (site)/                 # Route group: main site (shared header/footer/nav)
│   │   │   ├── layout.tsx          # Site layout (nav, footer)
│   │   │   ├── page.tsx            # Landing page (/)
│   │   │   ├── profile/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # Professional profile (/profile)
│   │   │   ├── projects/
│   │   │   │   ├── page.tsx        # Project gallery (/projects)
│   │   │   │   └── [slug]/
│   │   │   │       └── page.tsx    # Individual project (/projects/cool-thing)
│   │   │   ├── contributions/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # Contributions gallery (/contributions)
│   │   │   ├── blog/
│   │   │   │   ├── page.tsx        # Blog index (/blog)
│   │   │   │   └── [slug]/
│   │   │   │       └── page.tsx    # Blog post (/blog/my-post)
│   │   │   ├── resources/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # Resources page (/resources)
│   │   │   ├── about/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # /about
│   │   │   ├── contact/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # /contact
│   │   │   ├── colophon/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # /colophon
│   │   │   ├── now/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # /now
│   │   │   ├── sitemap/
│   │   │   │   └── page.tsx        # /sitemap (HTML sitemap)
│   │   │   └── slashes/
│   │   │       └── page.tsx        # /slashes
│   │   ├── (playground)/           # Route group: playground (minimal/no chrome)
│   │   │   ├── layout.tsx          # Playground layout (no nav/footer, style reset)
│   │   │   └── playground/
│   │   │       ├── page.tsx        # Playground index (/playground)
│   │   │       └── [slug]/
│   │   │           ├── page.tsx    # Playground item (/playground/my-toy)
│   │   │           └── embed/
│   │   │               └── page.tsx # Iframe embed route (/playground/my-toy/embed)
│   │   └── api/
│   │       ├── contact/
│   │       │   └── route.ts        # Contact form handler
│   │       └── playground/
│   │           └── [slug]/
│   │               └── route.ts    # Per-item playground API (when needed)
│   ├── components/                 # React components
│   │   ├── ui/                     # shadcn/ui primitives (managed by shadcn CLI)
│   │   ├── layout/                 # Site chrome: header, footer, nav, theme toggle
│   │   ├── mdx/                    # Custom MDX rendering components
│   │   └── shared/                 # Reusable components used across multiple pages
│   ├── lib/                        # Utilities and helpers
│   │   ├── utils.ts                # General utilities (cn(), etc.)
│   │   ├── content.ts              # Content querying helpers (get posts, filter, sort)
│   │   └── mail.ts                 # Resend email helper
│   ├── hooks/                      # Custom React hooks
│   ├── config/                     # Site-wide configuration
│   │   └── site.ts                 # Site metadata, nav items, social links
│   ├── types/                      # Shared TypeScript type definitions
│   └── styles/
│       └── globals.css             # Global CSS (Tailwind v4 import, theme variables)
├── public/                         # Static assets served at /
│   ├── images/                     # Site images (logo, profile photos, OG images)
│   ├── fonts/                      # Self-hosted fonts (if any)
│   └── static/                     # Velite-copied content images (gitignored)
├── playground/                     # Playground item source (colocated assets/styles)
│   └── [item-name]/
│       ├── index.tsx               # Entry component (dynamically imported by app route)
│       ├── styles.module.css       # Scoped CSS Module
│       └── [other files]           # Item-specific assets, helpers, sub-components
├── .velite/                        # Velite build output (gitignored)
├── velite.config.ts                # Velite collection schemas
├── next.config.ts                  # Next.js configuration (headers, redirects, webpack)
├── tsconfig.json                   # TypeScript config (strict mode, path aliases)
├── components.json                 # shadcn/ui CLI configuration
├── package.json                    # Dependencies, scripts, packageManager field
├── .nvmrc                          # Node.js version pin
├── .env.local                      # Local environment variables (gitignored)
├── .env.example                    # Documented env var template (committed)
├── .eslintrc.json                  # ESLint configuration
├── .prettierrc                     # Prettier configuration
└── .gitignore
```

## Naming Conventions

### Files

- **React components**: `kebab-case.tsx` (e.g., `hero-card.tsx`, `blog-post-card.tsx`). One component per file. The component itself uses PascalCase as a named export.
- **Route files**: Next.js conventions — `page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx`, `not-found.tsx`, `route.ts`.
- **Utilities/helpers**: `kebab-case.ts` (e.g., `content.ts`, `format-date.ts`).
- **Hooks**: `use-[name].ts` (e.g., `use-media-query.ts`).
- **Types**: `kebab-case.ts` (e.g., `content-types.ts`). Colocate types with the code that uses them when possible; only use `src/types/` for types shared across multiple directories.
- **Config files**: `kebab-case.ts` (e.g., `site.ts`).
- **Content files**: `kebab-case.mdx` (e.g., `my-first-post.mdx`). The filename becomes the URL slug via Velite's `s.path()`.
- **CSS Modules**: `[component-name].module.css` or `styles.module.css` when colocated.
- **Tests**: `[filename].test.ts` / `[filename].test.tsx`.

### Code

- **Components**: `PascalCase` named exports (e.g., `export function HeroCard()`)
- **Functions/methods**: `camelCase` (e.g., `getPostsByTag()`, `formatDate()`)
- **Constants**: `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` for true constants (e.g., `MAX_POSTS_PER_PAGE`), `camelCase` for config objects (e.g., `siteConfig`)
- **Variables**: `camelCase`
- **Types/interfaces**: `PascalCase` (e.g., `type BlogPost`, `interface SiteConfig`)
- **Enums**: `PascalCase` name, `PascalCase` members
- **URL slugs/routes**: `kebab-case` (enforced by content filenames and route folder names)

### Directories

- `kebab-case` for all directories (e.g., `hero-card/`, `blog-post/`)
- Exception: Next.js App Router conventions — `[slug]`, `(group-name)`, `_private`

## Import Patterns

### Import Order

1. React / Next.js imports (`react`, `next/...`)
2. External dependencies (`@radix-ui/...`, `clsx`, etc.)
3. Internal absolute imports (`@/components/...`, `@/lib/...`)
4. Content imports (`#site/content`)
5. Relative imports (`./`, `../`)
6. Style imports (CSS Modules)

### Path Aliases

Defined in `tsconfig.json`:

- `@/*` → `./src/*` (application code)
- `#site/content` → `./.velite` (Velite-generated content data)

### Module Rules

- Use absolute imports (`@/components/ui/button`) for cross-directory references.
- Use relative imports (`./hero-card`) only within the same directory or immediate children.
- Never use relative imports that go up more than one level (`../../` is a sign to use an absolute import).

## Code Structure Patterns

### Component File Organization

```tsx
// 1. Imports
import { ... } from "react"
import { ... } from "@/lib/utils"

// 2. Types (if component-specific and not exported)
type Props = { ... }

// 3. Component
export function MyComponent({ ... }: Props) {
  return (...)
}
```

- Server components are the default. No directive needed.
- Client components add `"use client"` at the top of the file. Push `"use client"` as far down the component tree as possible — wrap only the interactive leaf, not the whole page.
- No default exports for components. Named exports only. Exception: Next.js route files (`page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, etc.) use `export default` as required by the framework.

### Content File Organization

```mdx
---
title: "Post Title"
date: 2026-03-27
description: "Short description"
tags: ["tag-a", "tag-b"]
# ... other frontmatter per Velite schema
---

Content body in MDX.
```

- All regularly-updated content is MDX with frontmatter.
- Frontmatter schemas are defined in `velite.config.ts` — that is the single source of truth for what fields each content type has.
- Computed fields (slug, reading time, permalink) are derived via Velite schema transforms, not in components.

### Playground Item Organization

Each playground item lives in `playground/[item-name]/` at the project root:

```
playground/
└── pixel-art-editor/
    ├── index.tsx               # Entry component (must be a client component)
    ├── styles.module.css       # Scoped styles
    ├── canvas.tsx              # Sub-components
    └── palette.ts              # Item-specific helpers
```

The App Router route at `src/app/(playground)/playground/[slug]/page.tsx` dynamically imports the matching item from `playground/[slug]/index.tsx`. This keeps playground code separate from the main app while still being part of the same build.

Items needing full isolation use the `embed/page.tsx` route and are loaded via iframe from the parent page.

## Module Boundaries

### Dependency Direction

```
content/ (MDX files)
    ↓ (processed by Velite at build time)
.velite/ (typed JSON)
    ↓ (imported as data)
src/app/ (routes — orchestrate pages)
    ↓ (renders)
src/components/ (UI — receives data via props)
    ↓ (uses)
src/lib/ (pure utilities — no React, no side effects)

src/config/ → imported by app/ and components/
src/hooks/ → imported by client components only
src/types/ → imported by anything in src/
```

- **`src/lib/`** must not import from `src/components/` or `src/app/`.
- **`src/components/`** must not import from `src/app/`.
- **`src/components/ui/`** (shadcn) must not import from other `src/components/` subdirectories. Other components compose `ui/` primitives, not the other way around.
- **`playground/`** items may import from `src/lib/` and `src/components/ui/` but should be self-contained — minimize coupling to the main site.

### Route Group Separation

- **`(site)/`**: Full site chrome (nav, footer). All main content pages.
- **`(playground)/`**: Minimal or no chrome. Playground index and items. Own layout with style reset (`all: initial`, `isolation: isolate`, `@layer playground`).
- Both groups share the root `layout.tsx` for `<html>`, `<body>`, and global providers (theme, fonts).

## Code Size Guidelines

- **File size**: Aim for under 300 lines. If a file exceeds 300 lines, consider whether it has multiple responsibilities that should be split.
- **Function/method size**: Aim for under 50 lines. Extract helpers when a function does multiple distinct things.
- **Component complexity**: A component that takes more than 8 props is a signal to reconsider the API or split into composed sub-components.
- **Nesting depth**: Maximum 3 levels of nesting in JSX. Extract sub-components to flatten deeply nested markup.

## Documentation Standards

- Public utility functions in `src/lib/` get JSDoc describing purpose and parameters.
- Components do not need JSDoc — props types serve as documentation.
- Complex logic gets inline comments explaining *why*, not *what*.
- No README files per module. The structure.md (this document) is the project-level structural reference.
